arguments.summary: Six Columbus industrial refinance opportunities meet the criteria (confirmed active loans; executed-note maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31; no executed extensions; record owner and current Director of Finance verified since 2026-03-01). One duplicate pair (R2362/R7391) was shortlisted once. Exclusions were due to unconfirmed/inferred maturities, executed extensions, released/unknown loans, out-of-scope markets/asset types, stale ownership verification, or ineligible/invalid contacts. A prospect CSV with citations and selected facts has been created at artifacts/prospects-v1.csv.
limitations: Outstanding balances were not provided in the sources and are reported as null.
Eligibility and rankings rely strictly on sources published/effective on or before the 2026-08-31 cutoff; any later changes are not reflected.
One duplicate property record existed (Cypress Park 1); selection prioritized the team-page–corroborated base record.
Tie-breaking beyond the specified maturity then principal ordering was not defined; equal-principal items on the same date were ordered consistently but arbitrarily.
